text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft had her usual dream. Daring 
Heart and Air Messiah were coaching little 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Passing on one's feelings to someone else 
as a Tiara Umamusume. Rhein Kraft's heart 
leaps with excitement, wondering if she, 
too, is passing the torch to someone right 
now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, the Trainer and Cesario were 
worried about Rheingraft, who wouldn't 
wake up. She just kept sleeping on and 
on...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When Line Craft woke up, her Trainer took 
her to the hospital for an examination. 
However, the test results showed nothing 
abnormal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft told her Trainer that she had 
a wonderful dream while sleeping. Assuring 
them that she was fine, she showed great 
enthusiasm for the summer training camp.
